bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — Central CPZ (Centre), London Borough of Croydon (inner zone). Permit holders park in marked bays; visitors pay by phone (RingGo) or use a visitor permit. Zone centre point — the zone's streets are signed at its boundary. Sunday and evening charges apply in the Central CPZ: Sundays 1 hr £1.76/£1.99/£2.35 or all day £4.46/£5.05/£5.95; evenings 6pm to midnight at the same rates (charges schedule).
bays.times: Operational hours are shown on zone entry signs — the council does not publish a per-zone hours table
bays.tariff: Pay-by-phone bays (2-hour max stay), Mon-Sat during CPZ hours: 30 mins £1.57/£1.78/£2.10, 1 hr £3.18/£3.61/£4.25, 1.5 hrs £4.76/£5.39/£6.35, 2 hrs £6.37/£7.22/£8.50 (Band 1/Band 2/Band 3). Bands (CO2): Band 1 <1 g/km, Band 2 1-138 g/km, Band 3 >138 g/km, pre-March-2001 vehicles and non-Euro-6 diesels
bays.pay: RingGo (app, web or phone 0203 046 0010) or cash/card at PayPoint; visitor permits via residents
bays.permits: Resident permit (annual, charges from 7 April 2026): Band 1 £39, Band 2 (1-90 g/km) £89, Band 3 (91-130) £143, Band 4 (131-190) £199, Band 5 (>190) £342; pre-March-2001 cars £342 (over 1601cc) or £171 (under); second permit +£57, third +£171 (renewal only). Monthly permits also available. Visitor permits: £2.60/£2.90/£3.40 (Band 1/Band 2/Band 3) per half day; visitor day permit £4 (council charges schedule and visitor permits page)
